items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1961-06-20
items.q: This boy, Bonnell Snagel, a good piano player, the boy that died, Bonnell.

ctx.x: You remember anything about the Nancy Hanks?

Well, yes. I remember about that. I used to come down to that. I mean, a lot of prostitutes and so on used to be around now. Yeah, well, Ada Hayes ran and she was a madam. She was a barmaid too. Yeah, that was another tough spot. And that big 25, Iperville in Franklin. That's the place where all the big gamins are going. That's why they called it big 25, right at Iperville in Franklin. They tore that place down as a big parking lot now. Well, they had a piano in there too. A lot of all those musicians when they…
Which one is Brunnell's brother Cooney? Cooney, Cooney.
